records.title: Rajavallabha Nighantu
records.author: not_verified
records.reliability_notes: NOT the same work as source_vastu_raja_vallabha (Vastu Raja Vallabha / Rajavallabha Vastushastra) — do not merge. This is the WORK-level record (edition-neutral); concrete editions are separate records: source_rajavallabha_nighantu_edition_nepali_2024 (used for the current extraction) and source_rajavallabha_nighantu_1912 (Khemraj printed edition, retained for provenance). Traditional attribution per Shabdakalpadruma/Hindi Vishwakosh: dravyaguna-grantha by Narayanadas Kaviraj (per the Nepali edition's introduction; not independently verified). It is an Ayurvedic text (materia medica + dinacharya), not a Vastu text: every extracted record must be classified by what the source actually says (entry_type), and vastu_relevance must be none/potential/explicit per record — never assumed. Regional classification is to_be_assessed.
records.extraction_scope: source-specific knowledge section only; no Vastu rules without explicit in-source support

records.title: Rajavallabha Nighantu (Nepali bhavanuvada edition)
records.author: not_verified
records.commentator: Sanskrit root text compiled and translated into Nepali by Mohan Prasad Sapkota (as printed)
records.edition: Digital edition, Vikram Samvat 2080 Chaitra (as printed)
records.reliability_notes: Edition actually used for extraction in 11_rajavallabha_nighantu.json: OCR text layer (archive.org _djvu.txt) of the scan containing the Sanskrit root text with the editor's Nepali bhavanuvada. Structure: six parichchhedas (daily-routine chapters) with nested vargas; verse numbers restart per parichchheda and printed page numbers appear in running headers, so record IDs carry both. Distinct from the 1912 Khemraj edition (source_rajavallabha_nighantu_1912). Pending: visual proofread of extracted records against page images.
